conversation.user: I'm planning a backyard office. I have about 420 sq. ft. of exterior wall area, want 10-inch walls, and I care more about speed than hands-on mixing.
conversation.assistant: For a speed-focused backyard office with 10-inch exterior walls covering roughly 420 sq. ft., you will need about 10 to 12 m³ of material, and I strongly recommend using pre-cast hempcrete blocks since they arrive fully cured and save you weeks of mixing and drying time. Keep in mind that hempcrete is strictly non-load-bearing infill, meaning a conventional timber frame carries your roof and floor loads, and these numbers are just planning estimates rather than stamped engineering. Are you leaning toward a 12-inch wall for maximum thermal performance, or an 8-inch wall to preserve a bit more interior floor space?
